payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_spec_removing_a_name_another_reads_refuses_the_later_id stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'A refusal kind of its own, which `RefusalKind` and the count in §4.2.1 do not name.' applied to saffron/scheduler.py as an edit.
